title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
summary: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.
